# unifi_switch_lag (Data Source)

Retrieves a switch link-aggregation group (LAG) via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). LAGs are read-only on the Official API. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_switch_lag" "uplink" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the LAG to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The full LAG details, including type-specific fields, serialized as a JSON string.
- `members_json` (String) The LAG members (device id and aggregated port indexes) serialized as a JSON string.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the LAG entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `type` (String) The LAG type (e.g. `LOCAL`, `MC_LAG`, `SWITCH_STACK`).
